title: Mochizuki Honami — A Piece Of Kindness〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Thank goodness our new song's done.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The lyrics Ichika came up with are so amazing too...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Starting tomorrow, we need to learn to play this song while getting ready for our next show.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But before that can happen...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika, I know it's already pretty late, but please make sure to get to bed sooner rather than later tonight.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, she's right!
Since you said pulled an all-nighter.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was having so much fun working on our song that I'd completely forgotten.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, Honami.
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: At the same time, I've been wondering this whole time since we met in SEKAI... How did you know I stayed up all night?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, good question... It's one thing to be running early, but I couldn't tell that she pulled an all-nighter.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: About that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think it has to do with me helping out over at Ms. Yoisaki's house...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. She has a habit of staying up all night to work on her music.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She seems to take naps in between... But I can sort of tell whether or not she's actually gotten any real sleep because she seems... Different, I suppose...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... Different, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, Hona, does that mean you can sense people's auras?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, settle down. You know there's no way she can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In any case, you were behaving a little differently compared to usual, so I started wondering if you had pulled an all-nighter.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It just means Honami is just that good at looking after us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, that's not true.
I can still do better.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I really appreciate the fact that you're able to notice even the subtlest of changes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Once I get home, Honami, I promise to have dinner, take a bath and go straight to bed tonight.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you! Please get in a good night's rest.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I need to get home and start working on our schedule leading up to the show.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We don't have as much time as we usually do to practice, so this may be a close one.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And I may need to ask Ichika and the others to cut back on shifts and such...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm sure we all want Hanano and her brother to hear our song.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(We became scattered for a while...
So we sort of understand what it's like to be away from those we care about most.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Also, I want to do everything I can for those two since they're calling themselves Leo/need fans.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(So, I want our song to reach them.
I want our show to touch their hearts...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Which means we'll need a good practice schedule that can help us put on the best performance possible.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Well, that's easy to say...
But fatigue's going to build up each day.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Putting together a good schedule's one thing, but isn't there anything else I can do to help...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Yes! There is something I can do!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, I'll start working on it when I get home!
